subject: SDK instrumentation & observed model-variant skew — field repro + mitigation
summary: Field report from FinAi shows intermittent divergence in model variant selection and telemetry gaps. Sales Eng collected repro steps and traces; Platform (runtime) to add ephemeral variant tagging and SDK mapping to enable root-cause and short-term mitigation.
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@finai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SDK instrumentation & observed model-variant skew — field repro + mitigation

Hi Emma (and team),

Thanks for the quick signal on this. Summary of what FinAi's support team observed this morning: when they run the same prompt against our routed endpoint, around ~12% of requests return completions that are consistent with a different model variant (shorter context handling, different tokenization hints) and latency varies significantly. The customer sees this as an availability/consistency risk for their LLM-assisted workflows.

Marissa — flagged you to help collect repro and field artifacts. Logan — FYI from product/partner standpoint. Dev — can the runtime temporarily surface the variant tag used per request (via response header or extra telemetry) so the customer and our SDK can correlate? If we can annotate responses with a |X-Redwood-Variant: <variant-id>| header and return a mapping to request_id, that will buy us time to root cause whether routing, prefetch or quantization fallback is introducing the skew.

Emma — can you attach 2-3 representative request IDs and a short sample prompt (obfuscated) and confirm if the behavior is reproducible via SDK calls (curl or python)? Attached are a handful of the raw error lines FinAi pasted in chat.

Immediate ask: temporary instrumentation toggle + a short canary rollout plan so we can test on FinAi traffic without broad impact. Longer-term: SDK should expose request_id -> session mapping so SEs and customers can correlate response-level variant tags back to our telemetry.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Chen <emma@finai.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK instrumentation & observed model-variant skew — field repro + mitigation

Sean / team — thanks for the heads up.

We can add a short-lived response header |X-Redwood-Variant| fairly quickly and wire that into our request/response pipeline as a feature flag for specific customer routes. That will let you verify if routing is returning different model variants. Two quick asks to make the triage fast:

1) Please provide 2 reproducible request IDs (or full curl examples) that show the divergence. Having exact timestamps will help us match traces.
2) If possible, include a small span-level trace or the trace_id from the SDK (session/request) — that lets us jump to GPU-side logs.

If we can get those, I can: (a) flip the flag on the FinAi route in staging and add the header to responses, (b) run a short capture for 1k requests and give you the CSV mapping variant_id -> request_id.

Temporary mitigation options (quick):
- Force route to explicit variant (pinned variant) for FinAi while we investigate (impact: reduced capacity flexibility).
- Short-term SDK shim: emit the backend_variant field in client telemetry and attach to request metadata (low risk).

I'll allocate time on my side this afternoon to run the capture if we have the samples. ETA for the header flag in staging: ~3 hours after we have request examples.

— Dev

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Emma Chen <emma@finai.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SDK instrumentation & observed model-variant skew — field repro + mitigation

Adding the field repro steps and artifacts from FinAi. Emma attached a short trace and a session-id mapping; I've pulled the relevant pieces and sanitized them. Key observations:

- Repro steps (FinAi):
  1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"rwd-llm-4-multi","input":"<sample-prompt>"}'
  2) Repeat 50x with identical prompt and headers
  3) ~6 out of 50 responses returned variant id = rwd-llm-4-quant-8 and had ~20% lower token output (tokenization mismatch)

- Timestamps + request ids (sanitized):
  - 2028-07-25T08:54:23Z req: finai-req-001
  - 2028-07-25T08:54:24Z req: finai-req-019
  - 2028-07-25T08:54:27Z req: finai-req-033

- Runtime telemetry attached (finai_trace_0724.json) shows short KV cache reset events around the times above and a fallback path to a quantized kernel on a subset of calls.

Attachments included: finai_trace_0724.json (trace), seshid_map_0725.csv (req -> session mapping), finai_error_samples.txt (customer error notes).

Sales-eng asks:
- Dev: please enable X-Redwood-Variant header for the FinAi route in staging and run the 1k request capture you mentioned. Also a short CSV export (variant_id, request_id, timestamp).
- Platform/Product (Logan): if the quantized fallback path is being selected unexpectedly due to cache invalidation, we should evaluate a short config change to prefer full-precision variants for FinAi until we have a fix. That would be a policy change, not code.

Emma: can you confirm whether FinAi's SDK is using persistent connection pooling? That might influence session affinity and KV cache behavior.

Thanks — Marissa

Subject: Re: SDK instrumentation & observed model-variant skew — field repro + mitigation

Team — quick alignment and owners.

1) Dev: please proceed with the header flag in staging and the 1k request capture. Owner: @dev_patel. ETA: EOD (PST) today for the staging header; capture results + CSV tomorrow morning. Link the capture to INF-4821.
2) Marissa: coordinate a short customer test window with FinAi (10–15 minutes) to validate header presence and collect the CSV mapping. Owner: @marissa_cole. FinAi agreed to a midday window tomorrow.
3) Logan/Product: evaluate policy-level mitigation (pin variant preference for FinAi until root cause). If we go that route, confirm impact on capacity and cost. Owner: @logan_wright. Decision by EOD tomorrow.
4) SDK ask (short-term): expose backend_variant and request_id in client telemetry (no breaking API changes) so customers can map responses to our traces. Work to be scoped as low-risk patch.

I'll draft a short customer-facing status note after we have the staging header live. Emma — we'll confirm the test window once Marissa sets the time. Thanks for your patience — we'll treat this as high priority for the FinAi POC.

Regards,
Sean
